_about: The web app demonstration (for Ma'am): every feature, one chapter each, on real footage of the app on live data. No narration: a chapter title and a one-line caption on each. Pieces are the main film's demo shots (source timeline, chapter labels off) and scenes from render/scenes/tour.js. Music: audio/cut.py. Build: make -C film demo.

pieces.label: SEARCH ANY PLACE IN THE SKY
captions: Type the name of any object, or paste sky coordinates
It finds every SPHEREx image of that spot, live from NASA's IRSA archive

pieces.label: THE NASA CHALLENGE'S TEST TARGETS
captions: The challenge's five test targets are one click away
Each opens with facts from SIMBAD, the patch in other light from NASA SkyView, and its place in the sky

pieces.label: FAST STARS, FOLLOWED
captions: Barnard's Star moves 10.4″ a year across the sky
so its SPHEREx images are centred on where it is now; the cross marks where it was in 2000

pieces.label: NASA WISE: KNOWN MOVING STARS
captions: One switch adds NASA WISE data: CatWISE2020's known moving stars and brown dwarfs
each placed where it is on the frame's date. The brown dwarf WISE 0855 moves 8.1″ a year

pieces.label: BLINK THE FRAMES
captions: Every SPHEREx frame of the spot, in time order: step through, play, or blink two
Asteroid (7) Iris: 9.7 hours apart, it has moved

pieces.label: BRIGHTNESS ACROSS WAVELENGTH
captions: Every frame is measured at the target: across one pass, the points trace its spectrum
Its own moving-source search: of 1,405 sources, one moves in a straight line
Then NASA JPL's known asteroids: it is 7 Iris, 0.8″ from JPL's prediction

pieces.label: HONEST ABOUT WAVELENGTH
captions: It warns when a difference image would mislead: each frame sees a different colour

pieces.label: WHERE WAS SPHEREx?
captions: Where SPHEREx was in orbit for the frame on screen, from the frame's own record
Seventy-five years of sky surveys on one grid: Barnard's Star moves across them
A game on real SPHEREx frames that trains your eye
Every page in English and in Bangla

pieces.label: ASK, AND SEE THE SOURCES
captions: Ask about the view: answers come from the app's own measurements and JPL
and every answer lists its numbered sources

pieces.label: DISCOVER
captions: Discover: changes SPHEREx has seen, built from live data

pieces.label: ON A PHONE
captions: The whole app works on a phone, in either language
